changes.to: Menlo's own documentation page for Asimov 2 (checked 2026-11-17) says the page holds V2 concepts only and that full specs and the shipping date are unknown, so no specification can be recorded. Announced as the successor to Asimov 1.
Announced successor to Menlo's open-source Asimov 1; Menlo has published no specifications or shipping date yet.
